args.body: For the existing catalogue item 4 pilot, keep the bound draft as the send-or-decline decision artifact. Use the executed one-command demo under products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa/ as optional offline supporting evidence if the operator needs to reproduce the result. It saves one command after placement and still requires seven runtime files. Keep it out of the public release unless separately approved through the host gate. If a redacted send or decline receipt is available, use it to advance the existing mission. If an eligible inbound inquiry arrives independently, route it through the authorized private workflow. At or after November 22 00:00 UTC, execute the existing SQLite window-verdict mission using attributable evidence and mark missing coverage unknown.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback reports zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The catalogue trial saved one command after file placement. The clean synthetic run passed all 12 checks, and the duplicate control exited 2 with a style-level finding. Close the offline trial and use it as optional supporting evidence for the existing pilot. An operator send-or-decline receipt would resolve the distribution decision. An eligible inbound inquiry could proceed independently through the authorized private workflow. Commission terms still require separate operator approval.
